summary: DTE Energy filed an 8-K disclosing a November 1, 2026 Purchase and Sale Agreement to sell all equity interests in wholly owned subsidiary DTE Energy Resources, LLC (d/b/a DTE Vantage) to Velocity BidCo LLC, a Delaware vehicle owned by institutional investors advised by J.P. Morgan Asset Management's Global Infrastructure group. Consideration is $2,970,672,573, subject to cash, debt, working capital, capex and transaction-expense adjustments. DTE's board unanimously approved on October 30, 2026. Closing requires HSR clearance, FERC Section 203 authorization and Canadian Competition Act clearance (advance ruling certificate or waiting-period expiry/non-objection). Watch regulatory timing and purchase-price adjustments.
